_comment: Single source of truth for toolchain versions used by CI.
'toolchain' holds the defaults. 'branchOverrides' lets a specific branch
pin a different version; override keys are EXACT branch names (the target
branch on PRs, the pushed branch on push) and are shallow-merged over
'toolchain'. This repo has no develop branch, so overrides stay empty.
